decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range costs little to keep in the catalogue, and architectural hardware lifecycles typically span many years, even though it was not prominently shown in 2020-2021.
The multi-model handle family supports the firm's system breadth across budget levels, and the 2019 pruning of weaker designs suggests the remaining families were deliberately retained.
As the flagship electronic access system, it is central to the firm's strategic move toward digital building organisation and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
